newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar gains continue from festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar gains continue from festival demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices extended gains on Thursday on higher consumer demand ahead of festivals, dealers said.

They said there was higher outstation demand directly from mills, in turn reducing mill arrivals in the markets. Ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by five rupees to 1,255/1,280 while M-30 gained by eight rupees to 1,275/1,350. "The government has hiked stock limits for traders from 500 quintals to 1,000 quintals and has also increased the time limit for sale from 15 days to 30 days. Now traders can hold more stocks for a longer period," one broker said. "This could cut floating stocks."
